operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each engine-generator set (Ref. Nos. ENG1- ENG135)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: The permittee shall operate and maintain each engine-generator set and control device according to the manufacturer's written instructions or procedures developed by the permittee that are approved by the engine manufacturer. Settings may only be changed if permitted by the manufacturer and do not increase air emissions.

The approved fuels are diesel, renewable diesel, or a blend of these fuels. The diesel and renewable diesel fuels shall meet the ASTM D975 specification for S15 diesel fuel oil with a maximum sulfur content per shipment of 0.0015%.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Engine-generator sets ENG1-ENG20, ENG22-ENG41, ENG43-ENG72, ENG74-ENG103, ENG105-ENG134 (combined)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: 784,160 gallons diesel/renewable diesel per year. Throughput shall be calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Engine-generator sets ENG21, ENG42, ENG73, ENG104, ENG135 (combined)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: 5,032 gallons diesel/renewable diesel per year. Throughput shall be calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each engine-generator set (Ref. Nos. ENG1- ENG135)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Each engine-generator set shall be equipped with a non-resettable hour metering device to monitor operating hours and a fuel flow meter to monitor fuel throughput. These devices shall be observed not less than once each day the engine-generator set is operated, and a log of observations shall be kept.
